notes.subject: ol samting bilong kisim olsem bilong papa
notes.rationale: נחלה em i ol samting man i kisim long papa bilong en; Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok bilong en

notes.subject: yu — Yisrael
notes.rationale: Lo i toktok stret long Yisrael, olsem 'yu' long olgeta ples hia

notes.subject: כי...אין
notes.rationale: tok bilong gat/nogat i wskrim rot bilong lain Levi — em i no gat graun, olsem na ol narapel i mas lukautim

translation: Na man bilong lain Levi i kam, long wanem em i no gat hap, na i no gat ol samting bilong kisim olsem bilong papa, wantaim yu; na man i kam long narapela ples na i stap, na pikinini papa i dai pinis, na meri man i dai pinis, we ol i stap long ol dua bilong banis bilong yu, na ol i kaikai, na ol i fulap long kaikai, bilong Yahwe Elohim bilong yu inap barim yu long olgeta wok bilong han bilong yu we yu bai wokim.
